title: Ubiquity of Methanol and Its Related Chemical Segregation in Orion Starless Cores: The ALMASOP Sample
question: What are the detection rates, spatial distributions, and chemical segregation of CH3OH, N2H+, CCS, and c-C3HD in starless cores of the Orion A and B molecular clouds?

data.sensitivity: 0.5 mJy beam^-1 (0.2 mK) for continuum; 25 mJy beam^-1 (10 mK) per channel

what.value: Core masses (0.15 to 3.52 M_odot), JCMT 850 um continuum identification, and starless classifications based on WISE bands

evidence.quote: All these cores were classified as starless by (cite: 2018Yi_PGCC_SCUBA2_II) based on the absence of detections in the WISE bands (3.4–22 $\hbox{$\mu$m}$).
The core masses range from $0.15$ to $3.52$ $M_\odot$, reported by (cite: 2018Yi_PGCC_SCUBA2_II) based on their 850 $\mu$m dust continuum emission.

what.value: ALMASOP source catalog and target coordinate for G211.16-19.33N5

evidence.quote: As a result, the coordinate of it here is the targeted coordinate, which was based on the ACA images of (cite: 2020Dutta_ALMASOP).
In this study, we investigated 16 cold cores drawn from the ALMA Survey of Orion PGCCs (ALMASOP) project (cite: 2020Dutta_ALMASOP).

what.value: Prestellar core classifications and peak densities (2-8 x 10^7 cm^-3) for five cores

evidence.quote: Among the 16 cores, five of them show compact structures and extremely high peak densities (2-−8 $\times 10^7$ cm$^{-3}$) and are thus classified as prestellar cores (cite: 2021Sahu_ALMASOP_presstellar).

recipe.goal: Image ACA Band 3 continuum and molecular line datacubes
recipe.method: Clean continuum and spectral line visibilities using tclean with Briggs weighting

recipe.goal: Identify molecular line detections in ACA cubes
recipe.method: Search for voxels exceeding 5 times the rms noise level within a spatial and velocity sub-cube on non-primary-beam-corrected cubes
key_parameters: Circular region radius/aperture = 25'' (10,000 au), velocity range = v_LSR +/- 3 km s^-1, SNR threshold = 5
assumptions: Distance of ~400 pc for converting 25'' to 10,000 au

recipe.method: Integrate emission over the longest contiguous velocity channel range with signal > 3 sigma (and also a fixed v_LSR +/- 1 km s^-1 interval), then apply primary beam correction
key_parameters: 3 sigma contiguous channel threshold within 25'' and v_LSR +/- 3 km s^-1; fixed v_LSR +/- 1 km s^-1 for main text figures

recipe.goal: Derive molecular column density maps and peak column densities
recipe.method: Calculate upper state column density Nu from integrated intensity W and convert to total column density Ntot under optically thin LTE assumptions, measuring peak Ntot within a 25'' circular aperture
assumptions: Optically thin emission and LTE at fixed rotational temperature T_rot = 10 K
N2H+ flux multiplied by a factor of 9 based on 1:5:3 hyperfine ratio for the F1=0-1 group

recipe.goal: Reduce Yebes 40-m single-dish spectra and compare with convolved ACA data to evaluate missing CH3OH flux
recipe.method: Reduce Yebes Q-band CH3OH-3K spectra in CLASS/GILDAS, convolve ACA CH3OH-7K cubes to 36'' beam using CASA imsmooth, rescale ACA CH3OH-7K spectra to model CH3OH-3K spectra under LTE, and compare column densities
key_parameters: Convolved circular beam FWHM = 36''; Yebes extraction window = 5 MHz; modeled T_rot = 5 K and 10 K (and evaluated at 7.5 K)
assumptions: Optically thin emission and LTE across rotational temperatures (5 K, 7.5 K, 10 K)

score_reason: ACA project code, CASA version, robust weighting, cleaning thresholds, detection criteria, moment 0 integration windows, and LTE equations are clearly documented, and Table 1 provides numeric benchmarks for all 16 cores. However, two targets are accidentally omitted from the coordinates/v_LSR table, partition function values and several tclean parameters (cell size, deconvolver, masking) are unstated, and the Yebes single-dish spectra are not in the ALMA archive.
rediscovery_reason: The primary ACA dataset (2021.2.00094.S) is public, the detection criteria (5 sigma within 25'' and +/- 3 km s^-1) and LTE column density formulas are explicit, and Table 1 gives exact velocity integration widths and peak column densities for all 16 cores across 4 molecular species.
